title: Beyond Benchmarks: Dynamic, Automatic And Systematic Red-Teaming Agents For Trustworthy Medical Language Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ethics of medical LLMs through two of its four primary axes: 'Bias/Fairness' (evaluating equitable treatment across demographics) and 'Privacy' (evaluating adherence to regulatory and ethical standards like HIPAA/GDPR). It specifically tests the model's moral/ethical decision-making in clinical scenarios such as prognosis disclosure and triage.
